scenes.heading: Building long-term retainer relationships with brands

sents.d: Building long-term retainer relationships with brands
Recurring monthly work is usually more stable than chasing one-off gigs.

One-off projects require constantly finding new clients, while a retainer arrangement — a set number of videos or hours each month for an ongoing fee — creates predictable income and a deeper working relationship.

scenes.heading: Best with brands that post regularly

sents.d: Retainers tend to work best with brands that already post content regularly, since they have an ongoing need rather than a single event to film; approaching a happy one-off client about a monthly arrangement once trust is established is a natural way to start.

Price retainers slightly below what the equivalent one-off projects would cost individually, since the trade-off for the client is commitment and consistency, and the trade-off for you is guaranteed, recurring income instead of one-time payments.

take: Turn happy repeat clients into monthly retainers.
